questions: What does 'sum, modulo, of f(P)' mean? Is it sum of f(P) modulo some modulus, and if so, what modulus?
Is the modulus 998244353, as implied by the constraint that values are less than that modulus?
After each change, do we compute the sum over all paths using the updated grid at that moment, considering all previous changes?
Are the moves and updates cumulative? That is, does Takahashi's position update after each change, and the next move starts from the new position?
If a cell is visited multiple times by Takahashi during changes, does its value get overwritten each time?
Are the paths considered only the monotonic right/down paths from (1,1) to (H,W), or could they include other directions?
Does the initial position (sh,sw) affect the path sum calculation in any way?
Is the product f(P) taken modulo the same modulus as the sum, or is it computed exactly before summing?
